join.title: * PIXEL PARTY *
join.kicked: You were removed from the room by the host
join.tagline: {{n}} mini-games · one room · endless bragging rights

lobby.title: Lobby
lobby.share: Share the code or the link
lobby.waitingHost: Waiting for the host to start…
lobby.idealHint: Only games whose recommended player count fits this room
lobby.sittingOutHint: Picked games that don’t fit this many players: they skip this session and come back if the headcount changes

final.title: * FINAL RANKING *
final.waitingHost: Waiting for the host to start a new game…
spoonLines: Better luck in your next life.
Someone had to lose. Thank you.
The floor called. It misses you.

summary.title: Session summary
summary.radarHint: Dashed ring = the middle of the room · grey axes: not played yet

skip.hint: Skip this game for everyone (the round scores no points)
skip.doneSelf: You skipped {{game}}: no points this round
skip.failed: {{game}} broke down and was skipped: no points this round

rounds.autoHint: One round per picked game (up to {{n}})
rounds.repeatHint: More rounds than picked games: the line-up starts over (never the same game twice in a row)

picker.surpriseHint: Deal a random line-up from the games shown that fit this room

reason.no_games_fit: No picked game fits this many players
reason.invalid_name: Pick a name with some letters in it
reason.not_in_lobby: You can only change that in the lobby
reason.unknown_player: Your seat is gone — rejoin the room

reaction-duel.name: Reaction Duel
reaction-duel.blurb: Tap the instant the light turns green. Too early and you are out.
reaction-duel.tagline: Patience is a virtue. Jumping the gun is a loss.
reaction-duel.controls: SPACE / ENTER or click the moment it turns green

button-masher.name: Button Masher
button-masher.blurb: Mash as fast as you can before the timer runs out.

color-trap.name: Color Trap
color-trap.blurb: Tap the INK color of the word, not what it spells. Wrong taps cost a point.
color-trap.controls: 1–4 or click the tile of the INK color

trivia.name: Lightning Quiz
trivia.blurb: Answer fast — correct answers score, and speed earns a bonus.
trivia.controls: A–D or 1–4 · or click an answer

balloon-chicken.name: Balloon Chicken
balloon-chicken.blurb: Three balloons, the same for everyone: pump for points and cash out before each one pops.
balloon-chicken.tagline: Greed is good. Until it goes pop.
balloon-chicken.controls: SPACE pump · ENTER cash out · or click

number-rush.name: Number Rush
number-rush.blurb: Tap the numbers 1 to 25 in order as fast as you can — the ones left keep shuffling as you go.
number-rush.controls: Click 1 → 25 in order · wrong number = 0.5 s freeze

quick-math.name: Quick Math
quick-math.blurb: Solve as many sums as you can before the timer runs out.
quick-math.controls: Type the answer (ENTER if ambiguous) · or click it

odd-one-out.name: Odd One Out
odd-one-out.blurb: Spot the one tile that stands out. The grid keeps growing.
odd-one-out.controls: Click the odd tile · wrong tile = 1 s freeze

higher-lower.name: Higher or Lower
higher-lower.blurb: Higher or lower? Build a streak and bank it when you dare — a miss halves it.
higher-lower.controls: ↑ / W higher · ↓ / S lower · ENTER / B bank

bug-smash.name: Bug Smash
bug-smash.blurb: Smash the bugs, dodge the bombs. Fastest hands win.
bug-smash.controls: Click · or Q W E / A S D / Z X C · or NUMPAD 1-9

stop-clock.name: Stop the Clock
stop-clock.blurb: A hidden stopwatch: stop it at exactly the seconds it asks for — no needle, no numbers, just your gut. Three tries.
stop-clock.controls: SPACE / ENTER or click STOP when you think the time is up

memory-flash.name: Memory Flash
memory-flash.blurb: Count the flash — how many of the target colour did you see?
memory-flash.controls: 0-9 type the count · or ← → ↑ ↓ + ENTER · or click

simon.name: Simon
simon.blurb: Watch the sequence, then repeat it. It grows every round.
simon.controls: Q W / A S or 1-4 press the pads · or click them

pixel-hoops.name: Pixel Hoops
pixel-hoops.blurb: Charge and release to sink the basket. Chain them for combos.
pixel-hoops.controls: Hold SPACE or mouse to charge · release to shoot

pixel-weight.name: Pixel Weight
pixel-weight.blurb: A pixel object flashes — guess how many pixels it is made of.

pixel-split.name: Pixel Split
pixel-split.blurb: Cut the object in two halves with the same number of pixels.
pixel-split.controls: ← → or A D move the cut · ENTER / SPACE cut

tug-of-war.name: Tug of War
tug-of-war.blurb: Two teams, one rope. Mash together to pull the marker to your side.
tug-of-war.tagline: Teamwork: always someone else to blame.

sink-the-fleet.name: Sink the Fleet
sink-the-fleet.blurb: Head-to-head Battleship — a hit shoots again. Sink your rival's fleet before they sink yours.
sink-the-fleet.tagline: Somewhere out there, a tiny admiral is crying.
sink-the-fleet.controls: CLICK a cell or ←↑→↓ / WASD aim · SPACE / ENTER fire

bomb-relay.name: Bomb Relay
bomb-relay.blurb: Pass the bomb down your team — mash your leg and hand it off before the fuse blows.
bomb-relay.tagline: Hot potato, short fuse, shorter friendships.
bomb-relay.controls: SPACE / ENTER / CLICK mash while you hold the bomb

pixel-beat.name: Pixel Beat
pixel-beat.blurb: Tap along to the beat before it fades. Timing is everything.
pixel-beat.controls: SPACE / ANY KEY / CLICK on the beat

fleet-battle.name: Fleet Battle
fleet-battle.blurb: Team Battleship — a rotating captain calls each shot, then the whole crew can fire. Sink the enemy fleet first.
fleet-battle.controls: CLICK a cell or ←↑→↓ / WASD aim · SPACE / ENTER fire

maze-sprint.name: Maze Sprint
maze-sprint.blurb: Race through the same maze as everyone else. Fastest exit wins.
maze-sprint.controls: ← ↑ → ↓ or W A S D walk

line-clear-sprint.name: Line Clear Sprint
line-clear-sprint.blurb: Stack pixels, clear lines, beat the clock — but reach the top and you are out. Most lines wins.
line-clear-sprint.controls: ← → move · ↑ X Z rotate · ↓ soft drop · SPACE drop

quick-tetris.name: Quick Tetris
quick-tetris.blurb: A short, frantic Tetris sprint — first to clear the target lines wins.
quick-tetris.controls: ← → move · ↑ X Z rotate · ↓ soft drop · SPACE drop

bubble-pop.name: Bubble Pop
bubble-pop.blurb: Shoot color-matched bubbles to pop groups of three or more — the ceiling keeps dropping, faster and faster. Most popped wins; a full clear beats them all.
bubble-pop.controls: MOUSE or ← → aim · CLICK / SPACE fire

fruit-catch.name: Fruit Catch
fruit-catch.blurb: Slide your basket to catch the falling fruit — and dodge the bombs.
fruit-catch.controls: MOUSE or ← → / A D move the basket

pixel-rain.name: Pixel Rain
pixel-rain.blurb: Dodge the falling blocks. Last one standing wins.
pixel-rain.tagline: It's raining blocks. Nobody brought an umbrella.

pixel-dash.name: Pixel Dash
pixel-dash.blurb: Jump what rushes along the ground — but when a bird flies in, stay down. It keeps speeding up. Most obstacles passed wins.
pixel-dash.controls: SPACE / ↑ / CLICK: jump · birds: don’t jump!

snake-arena.name: Snake Arena
snake-arena.blurb: Your own board, the same apples as everyone: eat, grow, don't crash. Longest snake wins.
snake-arena.controls: ← ↑ → ↓ or W A S D steer

pixel-pong.name: Pixel Pong
pixel-pong.blurb: Head-to-head pong. First to five points takes the duel.
pixel-pong.tagline: Two paddles, one ball, zero mercy.
pixel-pong.controls: MOUSE or W S / ↑ ↓ move the paddle

sumo-push.name: Sumo Push
sumo-push.blurb: Shove and charge everyone out of a shrinking ring. Last sumo standing wins.
sumo-push.controls: ← ↑ → ↓ / WASD or MOUSE push · SPACE dash

match-pairs.name: Match
match-pairs.blurb: Flip the cards and clear every matching pair before anyone else.
match-pairs.controls: Click a card · or ← → ↑ ↓ / WASD + SPACE to flip

quick-draw.name: Quick Draw
quick-draw.blurb: Wait for FIRE, then draw first. Flinch early — or not at all — and you lose.
quick-draw.tagline: The undertaker is already taking measurements.
quick-draw.controls: SPACE / ENTER / CLICK draw — only after FIRE!

pixel-roulette.name: Pixel Roulette
pixel-roulette.blurb: Spin for a random number. Highest wins — pure luck.

sudoku-race.name: Sudoku Race
sudoku-race.blurb: Everyone solves the same mini sudoku. Fastest correct grid wins.

micro-race.name: Micro Race
micro-race.blurb: Tiny cars, tabletop tracks. Three laps, bump your rivals, fire your turbo, first across the line wins.
micro-race.controls: ← → A D steer · ↑ W gas · ↓ S brake · SPACE turbo · or mouse

dash-100m.name: 100m Dash
dash-100m.blurb: Alternate LEFT and RIGHT as fast as you can to sprint. Wait for the gun!
dash-100m.controls: Alternate ← → (or A D) to run · wait for the gun

hurdles-110m.name: 110m Hurdles
hurdles-110m.blurb: Sprint with LEFT/RIGHT and JUMP each hurdle. Clip one and you lose your speed.
hurdles-110m.controls: Alternate ← → (or A D) to run · SPACE / ↑ jump

long-jump.name: Long Jump
long-jump.blurb: Sprint down the runway, hold JUMP at the board to set the angle, release to fly. 3 tries.
long-jump.controls: Alternate ← → / A D · hold SPACE at the board, let go ~45°

javelin-throw.name: Javelin
javelin-throw.blurb: Build speed, hold THROW before the line to aim, release to launch. Longest throw wins.
javelin-throw.controls: Alternate ← → / A D · hold SPACE, let go ~45° to throw

glass-bridge.name: Glass Bridge
glass-bridge.blurb: Cross one by one: LEFT or RIGHT? Blind guesses that hold earn ★. Peeking at the glint is safe, but earns nothing.
glass-bridge.tagline: Half the panels are tempered glass. The other half are a funeral.

freeze-doll.name: Freeze Doll
freeze-doll.blurb: Hold to walk while she sings, freeze before she turns. Her laser spots any twitch!
freeze-doll.tagline: She sings, you walk. She turns, you'd better be furniture.

room-rush.name: Room Rush
room-rush.blurb: A number is called: pack a room with exactly that many. Shove, dash, slam the door!
room-rush.tagline: Musical chairs, except losing is permanent.
room-rush.controls: ←↑↓→ or WASD move · SPACE dash · or hold the mouse

sumo-ice.name: Sumo ICE
sumo-ice.blurb: Sumo on a melting ice floe: slide, shove and stay on the ice. Last one dry wins!
sumo-ice.tagline: The ice is thin. So is your dignity.
sumo-ice.controls: ←↑↓→ or WASD push · or hold the mouse

pang.name: Pang
pang.blurb: Harpoon the bouncing balloons: each hit splits them smaller. Most pops wins, dodge them all!
pang.tagline: Pop the balloons before they pop you.
pang.controls: ← → or A D walk · SPACE fire

star-blaster.name: Star Blaster
star-blaster.blurb: Same waves for everyone: weave through the bullet storm, your ship fires itself. Top score wins.
star-blaster.controls: ← → ↑ ↓ / WASD fly · or hold the mouse · fires by itself

asteroids.name: Asteroids Arena
asteroids.blurb: One shared wrap-around sky: rotate, thrust, shoot. Rocks pay, rival ships pay more!
asteroids.tagline: In space, no one can hear you blame the lag.

bomber-express.name: Bomber Express
bomber-express.blurb: Everyone starts maxed out: huge blasts, five bombs, fast boots. Last one standing wins!
bomber-express.tagline: Leave your friends a present. It ticks.

brawl.name: Street Brawl
brawl.blurb: One street, everybody fighting: punch combos, kicks, throws, pipes, bats, exploding fuel cans and chicken. Last one up wins!
brawl.tagline: Friendship ends where the bottle begins.
brawl.controls: ←↑↓→/WASD move · SPACE/J punch or use item · K kick · L grab

rally-stage.name: Rally Stage
rally-stage.blurb: Point-to-point against the clock: drift the gravel (pull the handbrake!), grip the tarmac, beat the splits. Fastest stage wins.
rally-stage.controls: ← → A D steer · ↑ W gas · ↓ S brake · SPACE handbrake · or mouse

speed-circuit.name: Speed Circuit
speed-circuit.blurb: Two laps wheel-to-wheel: tuck into the slipstream, hit the boost pads, fire your turbo, take the flag first.
speed-circuit.controls: ← → A D steer · ↑ W gas · ↓ S brake · SPACE turbo · or mouse

honeycomb-cut.name: Honeycomb Cut
honeycomb-cut.blurb: Trace the shape in the candy with your needle. Stray off the line or rush and it cracks — a broken candy counts half!
honeycomb-cut.tagline: Steady hands. Crack the candy and the candy cracks you.
honeycomb-cut.controls: HOLD THE MOUSE BUTTON + DRAG trace the line

jump-rope.name: Jump Rope
jump-rope.blurb: A giant rope swings faster and faster: tap to jump as it sweeps under you. Two misses and you are out!
jump-rope.tagline: Skip or trip. The rope doesn't care.

marbles-duel.name: Marbles Duel
marbles-duel.blurb: Odd or even? Hide marbles in your fist, bet on your rival’s. Win them all to win the duel.
marbles-duel.tagline: Take their marbles. Then take their dignity.
marbles-duel.controls: 1-9 / ← → count · SPACE hide · O odd · E even

weird-trivia.name: Weird Trivia
weird-trivia.blurb: Strange but true: pick the real answer among the absurd ones. Fast answers score more.
weird-trivia.controls: A–D or 1–4 · or click an answer

neon-trails.name: Neon Trails
neon-trails.blurb: Your bike leaves a wall of light behind it, and it keeps speeding up. Box rivals in, never crash: last rider wins.
neon-trails.controls: ← ↑ → ↓ or W A S D: turn · swipe on a phone
neon-trails.tagline: The wall behind you is yours. So is the blame.

wing-it.name: Wing It
wing-it.blurb: Tap to flap through the gaps between the towers — it speeds up and the gaps shrink. Last one in the air wins.
wing-it.controls: SPACE / ↑ / W or click / tap: flap
wing-it.tagline: Gravity always wins. Make it wait.

rock-paper-scissors.name: Rock Paper Scissors
rock-paper-scissors.blurb: The classic, 1 vs 1: throw at the same time, first to 3 wins — and every throw gives you less time to think.
rock-paper-scissors.controls: 1 2 3 / ← ↓ → / A S D or the buttons: rock · paper · scissors
rock-paper-scissors.tagline: Science says rock. Your rival read it too.

sharpshooter.name: Sharpshooter
sharpshooter.blurb: Bandits in the windows, bottles on the fence, cans in the air — and your aim sways with every breath. Hold it, squeeze, but spare the townsfolk.
sharpshooter.controls: MOUSE or ← ↑ → ↓ / WASD aim · CLICK / SPACE shoot · hold SHIFT / right-click: steady your breath · R reload
sharpshooter.tagline: This town ain’t big enough for your aim.

spook-snatch.name: Spook Snatch
spook-snatch.blurb: Grab the object shown exactly as it is — or, if none is, the one whose shape and colour appear nowhere. Fastest right answers score; a wrong grab locks you out.
spook-snatch.controls: 1–5 or click / tap the object · one grab per card
spook-snatch.tagline: The ghost took the photo. You have to guess what it was looking at.

hit-pull-twist.name: Hit, Pull, Twist!
hit-pull-twist.blurb: Do what it says, faster and faster — but obey the word, not the colour, flip it when it says UPSIDE DOWN and touch nothing on FREEZE. One slip and you are out.
hit-pull-twist.controls: ↑ W hit · → D pull · ← A twist · ↓ S shake · or tap the buttons
hit-pull-twist.tagline: Your hands know what to do. Your brain disagrees.

road-hop.name: Road Hop
road-hop.blurb: Hop across the traffic, then ride the logs over the river. Every crossing scores — squashed or soaked, you start again.
road-hop.controls: ↑ ↓ ← → / WASD hop (SPACE = up) · or the on-screen pad
road-hop.tagline: Look both ways. Then look again. Then run.

brick-buster.name: Brick Buster
brick-buster.blurb: Your paddle, your ball, the same wall as everyone: smash the bricks, catch the capsules, clear the wall for a bonus. Highest score wins.
brick-buster.controls: Mouse or ← → / A D move the paddle · on a phone, drag

munch-maze.name: Munch Maze
munch-maze.blurb: Gobble the seeds in the park maze before the pigeons peck you. Grab a chilli to scare them off — and tackle your rivals for their seeds.
munch-maze.controls: ↑ ↓ ← → / WASD turn · or swipe / the on-screen pad
munch-maze.tagline: The pigeons were here first. They will remind you.

sky-joust.name: Sky Joust
sky-joust.blurb: Flap over the lava and joust: hit a rival from above to unhorse them. Level clashes bounce, the lava bites, the ground crumbles.
sky-joust.controls: ← → / A D steer · SPACE / ↑ / W flap

bar-rush.name: Bar Rush
bar-rush.blurb: Four bars, a thirsty crowd: slide the drinks down to them, catch the empties coming back, and never let a glass smash.
bar-rush.controls: ↑ ↓ / W S change bar · SPACE / ← / A serve · or tap a bar

spectating: You are out — enjoy the show
Out. Your ghost may heckle freely.
Eliminated. Have you tried being better?
Out. Your funeral is next round.
Spectator mode: a fancy word for lost.
